# 10 — Modular Environment Kits

Kits snap to a **0.5 m grid with 2.5 m modules**, so player-built blocks (parts bible, 2.5 m large-grid cells) sit flush against authored spaces. Pivot rules: **corner** = bottom-left-back corner; **bottom-center** = centre of the footprint on the floor; **center** = volume centre. Kit libraries are generated with `exodus_levels.py kit --kit KIT-XXX` (one .blend per kit, every piece blocked out at size with its pivot).

## Kit rules

1. Every piece's footprint is a multiple of 0.5 m; wall lengths are multiples of 2.5 m.
2. Walls are 0.3 m thick (industrial) or 0.25 m (domestic); floors 0.2 m; ceilings 0.3 m, so a 2.5 m storey plus slab reads as 3.0 m.
3. Doorways match the parts bible door sizes (1.2 × 2.2 m and 2.4 × 2.2 m).
4. LOD chain as parts bible 00 (50/20/6%); collision ≤ 4 convex hulls per piece.
5. Trim-sheet texturing (parts bible 19) so kits accept faction skins.
